none: PAS NLM-7C6A86: Roman Coin: Radiate of Claudius II from Roxby cum Risby
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: C M CL[--]. Reverse description: Standing figure left holding cornucopiae in left hand and pointing with the right, possibly Providentia. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 19.5mm, Weight: 1.87gms, die axis: 12
